answer: To enforce robust Sybil resistance among autonomous agents, we deploy a zero-knowledge verifiable delay kernel that binds identity to a non-parallelizable sequential cost metric. In this framework, staking collateral is locked in a multi-party state machine, where any attempt to clone identities generates a cryptographic echo that triggers slashing penalties.
